title: HN-BIO 02: A Phase II Randomized Study of the Effects of Delayed Elective Radiotherapy on Head and Neck MRI and Immune Response Biomarkers
official: HN-BIO 02: A Phase II Randomized Study of the Effects of Delayed Elective Radiotherapy on Head and Neck MRI and Immune Response Biomarkers
summary: This is a single centre prospective exploratory study of effects of delayed radiation therapy on adaptive immune response in patients with newly diagnosed (head and neck squamous cell carcinoma) HNSCC receiving curative radiotherapy. This research is part 2 of the HN-BIO study.
conditions: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of Head and Neck

interventions.name: Standard of care external beam radiotherapy (single integrated boost)
Standard of care external beam radiotherapy (two-phase treatment)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>/= 18 years
* Histologically proven Head and Neck Squamous Cell carcinoma
* Primary or nodal disease \> 3cm for biomarker imaging
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0-2
* Planned for curative surgery or (chemo)radiotherapy
* Willingness to undergo repeat MRI imaging
* Able to receive and understand verbal and written information regarding study and able to -give written informed consent
* Adequate renal function: Calculated creatinine clearance \>/= 30ml/min
* Be able to lie comfortably on back for 1 hour

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently participating in another study that requires standard of care radiotherapy
* More than one contralateral nodal level requiring treatment in phase I
* As judged by investigator evidence of systemic disease that makes unsuitable for study
* As judged by investigator, it is deemed unsafe or medically inadvisable to conduct repeat biopsies
* Contra-indication for serial MRI scans
* Previous solid tumor treated within last 5 years that investigator feels makes unsuitable for study
* Pregnancy
* History of gadolinium contrast allergy
* Non-reversible clotting abnormality
* History of significant respiratory disease
